newsitem.title: USA: U.S. energy prices stay soft on ACCESS, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: U.S. energy prices stay soft on ACCESS, trade thin.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices retreated in thin after-hours trade, continuing a slump that began in the day session.
"People are on pins and needles ahead of the APIs," one trader said, referring to weekly U.S. inventory data.
Volume remained light on ACCESS with many traders taking vacations ahead of the U.S. Labor Day holiday September 2.
October NYMEX crude traded nine cents lower than its settle price of $21.62 a barrel. 300 lots traded early into ACCESS.
September gasoline added another 0.22 cent to its 1.60-cent slide during the day. It traded 61.40 cents on ACCESS, with 15 lots changing hands.
And front-month heating oil eased 0.03 cent a gallon to traded 61 cents as 40 lots were traded.
